title: GaitSettings
description: Data file content/behaviour/gaits.json (Marcel F5264 = A): how far an inhabitant walks per tick and which gait the core uses for a walk. One tick is one game minute, about 0.83 s real time at normal speed, so the metres per tick are also the speed the eye sees. The core reports the gait id in the inhabitant snapshot; the presentation plays the animation gait of the same id. The gait follows from data only, first match wins: pressing_need_gait if the walk's action serves a need below its neglect_below, then action_gaits, then default_gait. Factors are placeholders: look first, then tune.

walk_m_per_tick.description: Metres per tick of a factor-1 gait on flat meadow (shallow water and slopes slow it by the map's speed factor).

gaits.description: The gaits the core knows; ids match the gaits of content/animation/library.json.

default_gait.description: Gait of every walk that no other rule names.

action_gaits.description: Gait per action (action vocabulary), each action at most once.

pressing_need_gait.description: Gait of a walk whose action serves a need (the need of the action's first consideration in content/behaviour/utility.json) that is below the need's neglect_below in content/inhabitants/model.json. null = no such rule.

factor_of_walk.description: Speed as a multiple of walk_m_per_tick (placeholder).
